items.title: AFCS Architecture and Failure Logic
items.description: How the S-92's Automatic Flight Control System is built up layer by layer, followed through a real flight to show how the modes actually work together — plus every AFCS failure mode.

items.title: Electrical: Counting Down the Layers
items.description: Two generators, two converters, a backup and a battery — and what each layer costs you as it goes, down to why the gear must come down early.

items.title: Hydraulics: What the Aircraft Isolates
items.description: Five systems, two valves that close on a leak before you touch anything, and the drills that follow from what the aircraft already decided.

items.title: Fire: Where the Agent Actually Goes
items.description: Five infrared detectors, three arm buttons, two bottles — and the fact that the number two engine and APU share a compartment for extinguishing.
